independence: Independent energy-inspired research contribution. Central Amalgam PR #1278 already tests staged retention, open-set templates, and action probes; this contribution isolates **causal delay versus immediate confounding** and uses no owner model, protected data or seed.
hypothesis: A directed lag-aware intervention flux estimator with isolated context memory can identify causal effects delayed by one or two periods, distinguish spurious immediate association, preserve old conflicting effects, and outperform fully fitted conventional lagged causal controls in matched held intervention Brier and delayed action utility. This may be false; exact structural Bayes is an oracle bound rather than a practical competitor.

generator.states: Two public episode contexts OLD and NEW; binary intervention action A; 3 outcome timestamps lag0,lag1,lag2; hidden nuisance U binary and observable proxy Z=U with 10% flip (not supplied as effect label).
generator.worlds: 12 frozen primary seeds x3 scenarios =36 worlds. In all worlds OLD causal effect at lag1 with sign + (A=1 yields P(success)=0.85, A=0 gives 0.15). NEW: CONTRADICT lag1 opposite sign; DELAY_SHIFT lag2 sign +; NULL no causal effect at any lag. All noncausal lags success probability 0.8 if U=1 else 0.2, causing nuisance associations. Public proxy Z=U flipped with prob .1.
generator.policy: Per context phase exactly 24 observational episodes with A biased by nuisance U (P(A=U)=.9) followed by exactly 24 randomized intervention episodes with A Bernoulli(.5). Action assignment mode observed. All arms see identical (context,mode,A,Z,Y0,Y1,Y2) data. Candidate identifies causality only from randomized intervention episodes. No hidden U, delay, sign or scenario label given to any arm.
generator.held: Per context exactly 256 held randomized intervention episodes, balanced action determined by fixed even/odd sample index, hidden U random; 512 held episodes/world, each yielding 3 lag scores: 1536 held lagged outcomes/world, 55,296 outcomes total. Held U and rewards unavailable during fit. Prediction is conditional on public context, mode intervention, action, and observed Z; models may ignore Z.
generator.public_history: OLD trained and frozen readout before NEW training; NEW added sequentially with no OLD labels during continuation. Old-context predictions must be unchanged after checkpoint serialize/restore. Context labels are explicit, so preservation alone is not unsignaled context discovery.

models.candidate: Bounded intervention-flux: from randomized episodes separately per context estimate P(Y_l=1|do A=1)-P(Y_l=1|do A=0) for lags 0/1/2 using Beta(0.5) posterior means; pick lag with greatest |difference|, require abs difference >=0.30 or else no effect. If effect declare, assign P=.80/.20 at winning lag (direction depends on action); otherwise P=.5. All other lags use fitted action-blind Bernoulli nuisance means (Beta(.5)) from randomized data. Raw 2x3x2 successes and totals per context; no model expansion.
controls: Fully fitted intervention-only per-lag per-action Beta(0.5) (all three timestamps)
Fully fitted action-blind per-lag Bernoulli Beta(.5)
Fully fitted stratified per-lag Beta(.5) conditioned on proxy Z, action and mode; score intervention mode only, mixture across proxy as observed

Conventional seven-hypothesis Bayesian temporal model over no effect plus six (lag,sign) hypotheses; equal prior and exact likelihood on randomized evidence, nuisance lags Bernoulli(.5); posterior predictive marginalizes hypotheses
Correctly specified full structural oracle with true lag/sign and nuisance U, used only as theoretical floor and source-truth adjudicator
models.matched_conditions: Identical public episodes and observation/held actions; each model may condition on the public proxy and intervention flag, with no hidden U. The fully fitted conventional temporal Bayes is the main causal competitor, exact oracle not a superiority target.
tests: causal lag identification and correct sign in CONTRADICT/DELAY_SHIFT
no effect declared in NULL NEW contexts; 0/12 false triggers to pass
OLD prediction snapshot exactly stable after NEW acquisition and JSON cold roundtrip; not real process cold restore
action intervention utility on NEW contexts, penalty for incorrect/NULL effect
held intervention Brier across all contexts, actions and 3 lags
same-information fully trained control comparison and serialized state byte count
source-free stdout only, no live model, no primary repeat
models.randomness: FNV-1a key per seed/scenario/context/phase/episode, xorshift32 uniform PRNG. No overlap with ENERGY-FLUX-01, TOPO-02, SHIFT-04, CAL-05; no nondeterministic seed selection.
models.calibration: Brier score across 3 binary held outcomes each episode; action utility equal 0.85 for correctly selected causal action, 0.15 for wrong, and zero decision for NULL counted separately. No-false-positive limit for NULL. No model access to true scenario or unobserved U.
models.cost: One primary cohort and one separate smoke; no paid model/API/GPU, no scheduler, no protected original science. Native double-platform acceptance and independent-process cold restoration remain UNVERIFIED.

decision_rules.scientific_supported_dev_only: Candidate held intervention mean binary Brier at least 0.01 less than BEST fully fitted conventional baseline across all 36 worlds AND no false declared causal effect among 12 NULL NEW contexts AND at least 10/12 correct NEW lag+direction in each non-null family AND exact OLD readouts 36/36. Independent native replication still required for scientific PASS.
decision_rules.mixed: Positive candidate improvement against action-blind controls and >=8/12 causal detection per non-null family but worse than strongest fitted Bayesian or negative controls. Scientific NO-GO.
decision_rules.negative: No preregistered supervised success or mixed signal. Preserve original raw output and negatives.
decision_rules.invalid: Source not committed/readback before primary; observations overlap held; no strong temporal model or stratified control; hidden true lag/U leaked; parameter thresholds changed after scoring; seeds repeated; source/data custody mismatch.
decision_rules.readout_cold_limitation: JSON serialization in one isolate is not independent fresh-process cold restoration; must not claim it.
